project: Public acceptance-evidence protocol for a seated Meta Quest application

workload.reason: A reproducible official-source device-acceptance protocol is required before the native First Deal can be judged on Quest. This is narrower than sequence 13's compatibility matrix and does not repeat its exact query.

public_research_query: Using only current official public primary sources from Meta, Epic Games, Khronos, and Android, design a reproducible acceptance evidence protocol for a seated Meta Quest 3/3S application built with Unreal Engine 5.7.4. Focus on observable proof, not implementation advice. Cover: unchanged APK/AAB identity across tests; package signing, install, cold launch, relaunch, and log capture; controller and hand-tracking operation plus safe live modality switching; haptics and spatial-audio checks; mixed-reality passthrough/table placement/anchor recovery with a deliberate VR fallback; frame-time, thermal, memory, draw-call and battery evidence; accessibility/comfort checks suitable for adults ages 30-70; and two-headset tests that prove concealed card state is never exposed to the wrong player. For each test state the official source URL and title, supported observable signal, exact command/tool or device UI where officially documented, pass/fail evidence to retain, version/date limits, and any contradiction. Use at most 10 sources. Mark NOT ESTABLISHED whenever official sources do not define a method or threshold. Do not use private data, repositories, code, forums, blogs, social media, or third-party tutorials. Research only: no product verdict, legal conclusion, security certification, store approval, implementation decision, or external action.
objective: Return one bounded, cited acceptance-evidence protocol that converts current official Quest and Unreal documentation into falsifiable device checks for the native milestone.
difference_from_sequence_13: Sequence 13 asked for a platform compatibility and implementation matrix; this assignment asks for observable acceptance evidence and retained proof.
Sequence 13 stopped before provider submission; this assignment uses the owner-authorized authenticated Chrome surface because the API profile remains disabled and uncredentialed.
The exact sequence-13 query and digest are not reused.
non_goals: No repository, source code, commit identity, private project fact, credential, account detail, Slack, Linear, provider output, or concealed live gameplay state
No programming, product decision, committee vote, review verdict, legal conclusion, security certification, store approval, implementation authority, or external write
No audience-culture, music-rights, comparable-product, monetization, or broad product-direction research
constraints: Submit the exact public query once in the authenticated Perplexity Chrome surface
Use at most 10 official primary sources from Meta, Epic Games, Khronos, or Android
Record observable signals, documented tools or commands, evidence to retain, visible dates or version limits, contradictions, and unsupported rows
Mark unsupported methods or thresholds NOT ESTABLISHED instead of inferring them
Do not expose cookies, tokens, keys, browsing history, personal data, local paths, repository details, or private context
No recovery attempt unless the first submission fails transiently before a usable response; never repeat an ambiguous successful submission

Firecrawl for independent verification of public official pages only

OpenAI records provenance and scope review before workload credit is applied

Authenticated browser conversation URL and retrieval timestamp without cookies or account identifiers
Raw terminal response retained as an inbound artifact without secrets
Normalized source/test matrix with direct URLs and verification status
Usage or cost shown by the surface when available; otherwise NOT ESTABLISHED
